Memberwise equality gives the actual equal pivot and buckets; the valid branch returns directly, the invalid branch executes run_nil and adds its two calls. Positive size uses n+1 for the finite occurrence domain. No computational definition, artificial work assignment or new execution is introduced.

These marginal and expectation laws project the same run. Scan equals input length for all natural sizes and all worker ranks, including zero and invalid. The all-equal premise is the precise counterfamily scope, not a weakening of previous universal expected/tail results.

For every n>=2 and all worker ranks, every supported replicate outcome has scan n strictly below n(n+1)/2. This preserves the required worst-case quantifiers; it does not refute existence of distinct-input worst paths or prove C064.
